purpose: Test inputs defined BEFORE generation: required shape, features, dimensions, relationships, tolerances; provenance per requirement (ink / notes / clarification / frozen policy); classification per the issue.
method: Ink facts read from the source drawing PNGs by vision transcription (never from reference geometry). Notes and clarification answers are the frozen TRIAL-PLAN.json values. Reference measurements come from references/reference-measurements.json and are used ONLY by the evaluator, never sent to the model.

substitutions.requested: a missing-thickness case from the existing corpus
substitutions.reason: The corpus entries that carried the missing-thickness role (missing_thickness, profiles_empty_notes) were deleted in the logged plan revision and predate this record-keeping. 008 is the strongest remaining missing-thickness case: ink shows wall thickness implied only (concentric rectangles), the floor is never drawn, and no numeric thickness exists. Its GT (vol 67548 mm3 of a 120x80x40 outer box) is consistent with the frozen 3 mm clarification answer, making it the counterexample that a pre-fixed clarification CAN match the reference.
